siteErrors.title: PHP errors by release
siteErrors.subtitle: Errors, warnings and fatals of the live containers, grouped by message and file:line, attributed to the release that served them. Collected every minute.
siteErrors.empty: No PHP error recorded for this site.
siteErrors.emptyFiltered: No PHP error for these filters.

explain.readOnlyWrite: The live code is read-only: the site tried to write next to its code. Declare that folder as a data path (Configuration tab), then publish again.
explain.execRefused: PHP only runs code from the release: a script under a data path or /tmp is refused. Put the PHP file in the code (staging) and publish.

siteErrors.loadFailed: Failed to load the PHP errors
